matches.rationale: Finding 4 directly identifies that Lemma 3.1's hypothesis (δ_p > 5||E||) is inconsistent with the 4||E|| ≤/< δ_p conditions used in Theorems 2.1-2.3, exactly the strict/non-strict and threshold mismatch the ground truth describes, and even shows the paper's own derivation only needs the 4||E|| bound.

No finding addresses the specific ambiguity in Theorem 2.3 about whether the maximum of |f(z)| over Γ1 is taken over the boundary or interior of the rectangle; findings 8 and 12 discuss different issues (rank-p approximation identification and an M2 bound derivation error) involving Theorem 2.3's quantities but not this notational ambiguity.
